## Items (last 24h, all source-verified)

1. **[TNSTC] Vetri Payanam free travel goes live Oct 2** — 12,692 buses across 7 transport corporations; ~84.32 lakh women/day; expanded from ordinary to Express, LSS & Deluxe city buses plus mofussil ordinary and hill-route ordinary (>40 km). Launch events: Koyambedu + Ambattur, Chennai. — ANI, Oct 1 (updated Oct 2): https://www.aninews.in/news/national/politics/tamil-nadu-cm-vijay-to-launch-expanded-vetri-payanam-free-bus-scheme-for-women-on-oct-2-covers-12692-buses-8432-lakh-beneficiaries20261001105826 (DT Next confirmed morning-of launch: https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/tns-vetri-payanam-scheme-how-far-can-women-travel-for-free-on-express-lss-and-deluxe-buses)
2. **[CMRL] Gandhi Jayanti service change (today)** — Sunday timetable, trains 5 AM–11 PM; 7-min headway 12–8 PM, 10-min early morning/evening, 15-min after 10 PM. — Live Chennai, Oct 1: https://www.livechennai.com/detailnews.asp?newsid=83489
3. **[CMRL] Phase 2 first stretch opens Oct 11 — fine print** — Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani, 14.64 km; 11 of 17 stations initially (Porur Jn–Vadapalani double-decker section stations deferred); 15 trains, 10-min headway; max fare ₹40 on stretch, ₹50 to Central/Egmore/Airport; UTO/driverless only by mid-2027 (120 test cases pending before CMRS certification; ATO with 2 operators meanwhile). — ET Infra/TOI, Oct 1: https://infra.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/urban-transportation/chennai-metro-phase-2-stretch-to-open-on-oct-11-trains-will-not-be-driverless-until-mid-2027/134614453 (also Swarajya, Oct 1: PM Modi to inaugurate)
4. **[CMRL] TBM hat-trick in 3 days** — 'Adyar' broke through at RK Salai (Oct 1) after a 277-day drive from Royapettah (started Dec 29, 2025), passing Peters Bridge, EPFO building, Andhra School; 'Kaveri' (Sep 29) at Kilpauk Medical College, 'Maruthan' (Sep 30) at Villivakkam Bus Terminus. Corridor 3's 12-km Kellys–Taramani underground by L&T with 8 TBMs. — DT Next, Oct 2: https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/tbm-adyar-breaks-through-at-rk-salai-cmrl-achieves-hat-trick-in-three-days (also RailAnalysis, Oct 1: https://railanalysis.in/metro/chennai-metro-phase-2-achieves-tunnelling-milestone-with-tbm-marutham-breakthrough-at-villivakkam-metro-station)
5. **[SR] Gandhi Jayanthi long-weekend specials** — 06023 Chennai Central–Podanur (11:55 pm Oct 1), 06123 Tambaram–Tenkasi (11:55 pm Oct 1), unreserved 06159 Tambaram–Manamadurai MEMU, 06055/56 Egmore–Ernakulam, Bengaluru–Chennai specials Oct 1 & 4; bookings opened Oct 1, 8 AM. — Live Chennai, Oct 1: https://www.livechennai.com/detailnews.asp?newsid=83475
